description: National Risk Index Annualized Frequency Hail is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by FEMA AGOL. National Risk Index Version: March 2023 (1.19.0) Hail is a form of precipitation that occurs during thunderstorms when raindrops, in extremely cold areas of the atmosphere, freeze into balls of ice before falling towards the earth's surface. Annualized frequency values for Hail are in units of events per year. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of FEMA AGOL. Its keywords are County, Census Tract, Feature Layer, Feature, Query, National Risk Index, NRI, The National Risk Index. The bounding box given is -179.1473,18.9108,179.7785,71.3905. The hub shows 2023-03-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open.
